chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: Should I choose Replacement Cost or Depreciated Value for personal property?

chunks.text: Replacement Cost pays to replace your belongings with brand-new items of similar kind and quality without deducting for depreciation. Depreciated Value (Actual Cash Value) only pays what your items are worth today considering age and wear. Replacement Cost provides more complete protection for your possessions.
